newsitem.title: DUBAI: Dubai takes 10 pct equity in Emaar Properties.
newsitem.headline: Dubai takes 10 pct equity in Emaar Properties.

text.p: The Dubai government said its stake in the newly formed Emaar Properties will be 10 percent, United Arab Emirates (UAE) newspapers reported on Tuesday.

"The Dubai government last night announced that its promoter's stake in the newly floated Emaar Properties will be 10 percent costing 100 million dirhams ($27.2 million)," the English-language Gulf News said.
Emaar last week raised the amount of its initial public offering by 85 percent to one billion dirhams on instruction from Dubai ruler and UAE Prime Minister Sheikh Maktoum bin Rashid al-Maktoum.
Emaar had initially offered 29.7 million shares at 10 dirhams each to UAE nationals. Seventy nine founder shareholders committed 243 million dirhams. Subscription closes on Tuesday.
